articles.title: Oscar Magrini revela vontade de voltar às novelas  | G1
articles.standfirst: Em entrevista ao g1, o ator nascido em Santos (SP) falou sobre a carreira, o relacionamento de 36 anos com a atriz Matilde Mastrangi e a relação com o envelhecimento.
articles.summary: Em entrevista ao g1, Oscar Magrini relembra o sucesso de Ralf, em O Rei do Gado, o casamento com Matilde Mastrangi e o desejo de retornar à televisão brasileira.
articles.body:
Oscar Magrini interpretou Ralf, em 'O Rei do Gado' — Foto: Reprodução/Memória Globo e Arquivo Pessoal

Oscar Magrini, de 65 anos, ficou conhecido nacionalmente após interpretar o vilão Ralf, na novela 'O Rei do Gado', da TV Globo, em 1996. Em entrevista ao g1 , o ator contou que era muito assediado pelo público, que, segundo ele, acaba confundindo o artista com o personagem.

"O Ralf só tinha 30 capítulos de vida, mas fez tanto sucesso que me mataram no 135 e virou 'quem matou o Ralf?'. Não era para ser nada disso. Eu consegui fazer de um cafetão, de um cara que batia em mulher, violência contra mulheres, ser um cara marcado até hoje. Já faz 30 anos e as pessoas não esquecem. Então, deixei minha marca na televisão brasileira ", afirmou Magrini.

Nascido e criado em Santos , no litoral de São Paulo, o ator fez mais de 40 novelas, 30 filmes e 15 peças de teatro ao longo dos 36 anos de carreira. Longe da televisão brasileira desde 2021, ele afirmou que tem vontade de voltar, mas precisa de um convite e de boas condições para aceitá-lo.

" Não faço mais um galã, mas eu faço um tio, faço um avô, faço um paizão, entendeu? Mas, ficam insistindo nessa coisa de colocar gente nova, molecada nova, colocar influencer [...]. Não preciso fazer novela por enquanto. Se me chamar, ótimo. Se não chamar, eu estou fazendo teatro", disse.

Magrini, inclusive, tem viajado o Brasil com a peça 'Troca Ou Não Troca' e se apresenta no Teatro Municipal Procópio Ferreira, em Guarujá (SP), neste domingo (18). O ator também tem se dedicado às novelas verticais, produzidas para assistir pelo celular, além de projetos no cinema.

Durante a entrevista, ele também falou sobre a relação com a Baixada Santista (SP) e o segredo para o casamento de mais de três décadas com a também atriz Matilde Mastrangi , considerada um dos grandes nomes da era da pornochanchada do cinema brasileiro. Veja abaixo:

Qual é a sua relação com a Baixada Santista? Você saiu da região para investir na carreira artística?

Eu nasci em Santos no dia 2 de setembro de 1961 na Beneficência Portuguesa, às 2h50 da madrugada. Morei em Santos até 1990. Depois, eu casei e mudei. Sou casado há 36 anos. Eu nasci na Rua Carvalho de Mendonça. A minha casa era muito grande e meu pai vendeu a casa para o colégio Ateneu Santista. Aí eu fiquei dois anos e meio no bairro Marapé e meu pai comprou a casa na Euclides da Cunha, Canal 1. Eu tinha 11 anos de idade, e hoje funciona o Espaço Cultural Oscar Magrini.

Nessa minha casa, me formei em Educação Física na Fefis, e aí eu dei aula no Saldanha da Gama, montei toda a academia do Saldanha da Gama de 1982 a 1987. Eu trabalhava na Sabesp, Saneamento Básico do Estado de São Paulo, das 7h às 18h. Às 18h, eu ia para o Saldanha dar aula de ginástica até às 22h. Em 1987, eu montei a minha locadora de vídeo, eu e a minha irmã, chamava-se Videoteca, e aí montei uma academia de ginástica. Fiquei um ano e pouco lá, depois vendi meus pesos, vendi minha locadora e fui batalhar para fazer teatro. Ensaiava 12 horas por dia. Tinha um Fiat Uno, dividia com quatro atores para rachar gasolina, Santos e São Paulo todo dia, ensaiar 12 horas por dia para não ganhar nada.

Aí teve um anúncio no jornal que a atriz Matilde Mastrangi estava produzindo uma peça, 'Uma Ilha Para Três', [...] e tinha um teste para ator. Eu era modelo, fazia filmes publicitários, fotos e desfiles nessa onda. Aí eu fui fazer o teste e passei na frente de 20 atores. Então, em 1990, eu fiz a minha primeira peça profissional, 'Uma Ilha Para Três'. Em 1991, meu primeiro filme, 'Perfume de Gardênia', de Guilherme de Almeida Prado. Em 1992, minha primeira novela, 'Deus Nos Acuda', de Silvio de Abreu, na Globo. E aí eu não parei mais. São 36 anos de carreira, são 40 novelas, eu estou viajando no Brasil com a minha 17ª peça, Troca ou Não Troca, que estará em cartaz dia 18 agora no Guarujá, no Teatro Procópio Ferreira. E eu acabei de fazer o meu 31º filme, 'Saidinha de Natal', do Danilo Gentili.

Comédia 'Troca-Troca' com Oscar Magrini será apresentada no Teatro Polytheama em Jundiaí — Foto: Ronaldo Gutierrez/Divulgação

O que te fez trocar a Educação Física e a locadora pelo teatro?

Eu montei a Videoteca porque era cinéfilo, eu sempre gostei de cinema. Via novela desde preto e branco, desde criança. Sempre quis fazer televisão, conhecer esses artistas, queria ser amigo deles, trabalhar com eles, e Deus permitiu isso. Uma historinha rápida. Em 1973, teve a primeira versão na Tupi de 'Mulheres de Areia', com Eva Wilma, Carlos Zara e Gianfrancesco Guarnieri. Muito bem. Enchi o saco da minha mãe que eu queria fazer a gravação. A gravação dessa novela era na Praia do Sonho, em Itanhaém. Aí foi minha mãe, meu irmão, minha irmã, fomos lá de ônibus até Itanhaém, não tinha gravação nenhuma. Mas, eu fui na Praia do Sonho e eu vi a casinha da Ruth e Raquel, porque aparecia na televisão para a gente. As externas eram na Praia do Sonho, em Itanhaém, depois para o estúdio da Globo. Muito bem, isso foi em 1973. Vinte anos depois, eu fiz 'Mulheres de Areia' com Carlos Zara. Era uma coisa que tinha que acontecer. Vinte anos depois que eu fui menino assistir as gravações, eu estava fazendo a própria novela, a segunda versão de 'Mulheres de Areia' em 1993.

Você interpretou Martim Afonso de Souza na Encenação da Fundação da Vila de São Vicente, considerado o maior espetáculo teatral de praia do mundo. Como foi voltar à região onde nasceu e dar vida a uma figura tão importante para a história do Brasil?

Essa figura tão importante para a história que eu processei até a prefeitura. Em 1999, eu fiz o Martim Afonso de Sousa. Em 2000, naquela virada do milênio e tal, eu interpretei Pedro Álvares Cabral. Aí em 2014, eu fiz de novo o Martim Afonso de Sousa. Nessa vez que me prejudicaram, que eu acho que foram fazer de sacanagem, minha figura estampada no carnê de IPTU. Isso foi em janeiro, uma amiga me liga em novembro: "Ei, Magrini, é importante mesmo, hein? Recebi você aqui em casa". Como assim? Não entendi. "Moro em São Vicente. Recebi o carnê de IPTU e você está na capa como Martim Afonso". "Eu estou na capa? Manda uma foto". Aí já meti o processo, já ganhei as três instâncias, já faz oito anos, estou para receber os precatórios. Semana passada meu advogado ganhou a segunda causa, que era o uso indevido de imagem. Então, foi R$ 50 mil, mas já está em R$ 290 mil esse negócio. Eu processei porque foi uso indevido de imagem, mas está tudo bem. Eu adorei fazer o Martim Afonso de Sousa, é uma emoção incrível.

Oscar Magrini processou a Prefeitura de São Vicente por uso de imagem em carnê de IPTU — Foto: Alexsander Ferraz/AT e g1 Santos

Você ficou muito conhecido como galã nos anos 1990, especialmente por personagens como Ralf. Como foi viver aquele momento de popularidade? Você sentia que o público confundia o ator com os personagens?

Sempre confundiam. Nessas 40 novelas, 'O Rei do Gado' foi em 1996, hoje faz 30 anos. Então, eu tinha muito assédio, era muito assediado, mas o homem não podia reclamar de assédio, senão achavam que era gay. Desde então, até hoje as pessoas falam: "Ei, Rei do Gado. Fala, Ralf". "Rei do Gado, não. Sócio dele". Eu brinco, né? Faz 30 anos e a mulherada não esqueceu. Sempre reprisa porque é uma obra do Benedito Ruy Barbosa fantástica, onde o meu personagem, o Ralf, só tinha 30 capítulos de vida, mas fez tanto sucesso que me mataram no 135 e virou "quem matou o Ralf?". Não era para ser nada disso. Eu consegui fazer de um cafetão, de um cara que batia em mulher, violência contra mulheres, ser um cara marcado até hoje. Já faz 30 anos e as pessoas não esquecem. Então, deixei minha marca na televisão brasileira.

Ao longo desses 36 anos de carreira, você passou por novelas de grande repercussão, cinema e teatro. Qual trabalho mais marcou sua trajetória e por quê?

Tem exatamente esse que nós estamos conversando. Há 30 anos, o Ralf, do 'Rei do Gado'. Dois anos depois, 'Torre de Babel' quando eu fazia o Johnny Percebe, o Augustinho. O 'Rei do Gado', o Ralf, era mais forte o personagem do que ator. As pessoas falavam: "Quem fez o Ralf, aquele cafetão, como é?", "O Oscar Magrini". "É. Esse ator, o Oscar Magrini". O Ralf é mais conhecido que o Oscar Magrini.

Dois anos depois, eu fiz uma novela do Silvio de Abreu, 'Torre de Babel', onde eu trabalhava no ferro velho com Juca de Oliveira, Tony Ramos. Aí todo mundo falava: "E aí, Magrini. Fala, Percebe". Aí já era o Oscar Magrini que fazia o Percebe, entendeu? De todos os personagens, o que eu guardo lá em cima na prateleira, que me deu visualização, me deu credibilidade e fiquei conhecido tanto no Brasil como no exterior, porque a Globo vende para 196 países. Foram esses dois, o 'Rei do Gado', o Ralf, em 1996 e 'Torre de Babel', Johnny Percebe, em 1998. Aí depois já era o Oscar Magrini, veio essa coisa toda e onde eu vou as pessoas, eu vou de boné, de óculos. "Não adianta disfarçar não, reconheci pela voz". "Ah, reconheceu pela voz? Eu não posso dar trote?". "Não, sua voz é conhecida". Então, quando eu vou no Brasil e lá fora, as pessoas conhecem bem. Há cinco anos, eu faço um trabalho de apresentar prêmios internacionais, Paris, Roma, Nova York, Londres, Bruxelas, na Bélgica, e Londres. Então, eu vou direto todo ano, esse ano já fui para Paris, ainda falta Londres. Vou duas ou três vezes para o exterior apresentar um prêmio. Por quê? Por causa do reconhecimento do Oscar Magrini, que é conhecido, por causa da novela, dos meus trabalhos. Então, isso é muito legal.

Oscar Magrini em 'Torre de Babel' e atualmente — Foto: Reprodução/TV Globo e Arquivo Pessoal

Tem vontade de voltar à televisão? O que precisaria acontecer para esse retorno?

Eu digo assim, que graças a Deus, eu continuo trabalhando e Deus abrindo portas, porque na nossa profissão é muito difícil você chegar, mas não é impossível. O mais difícil ainda é permanecer na profissão porque eu já tive 30, o Ralf tinha 35, eu tive 40, já tive 50, eu estou com 65 anos. Eu não faço mais um galã, mas eu faço um tio, faço um avô, faço um paizão, entendeu? Mas, ficam insistindo nessa coisa de colocar gente nova, molecada nova, colocar influencer. Eu estou comentando uma coisa que eu escuto, o meu Instagram é aberto. Então, as pessoas falam: "Nossa, eu gosto das novelas antigas, você tem que voltar para as novelas". Eu também quero, mas preciso ser chamado. O salário diminuiu, eu sou de São Paulo, eu preciso de uma passagem aérea, eu preciso de um hotel. Então, são gastos. A não ser que queiram muito mesmo, eles me chamam e pagam isso, mas eu não preciso fazer novela por enquanto. Se me chamar, ótimo. Se não chamar, eu estou fazendo teatro, viajando pelo Brasil com a peça 'Troca ou Não Troca'.

A última vez que eu fiz um seriado foi no Multishow, em 2021. Aí depois não fiz mais novela, só filmes. De lá para cá, eu fiz seis, sete filmes e teatro. Peça é a segunda peça já, eu fiz o 'O Vison Voador' e o 'Troca ou Não Troca', então as duas juntas já são quatro anos de teatro. Junto com o cinema e esses prêmios internacionais que eu te falo. Lógico, eu gostaria de fazer novela, a novela é muito bacana. A cultura brasileira é televisiva. Primeiro lugar, está a televisão, depois está o cinema e não faltando tempo, dinheiro e vontade você vai para o teatro, infelizmente. Mas, eu continuo fazendo muita publicidade. Se você ver o meu Instagram, eu tenho um monte de publicidade que eu faço por ser Oscar Magrini, por ter uma idoneidade, por ser um cara responsável, já casado há muito tempo, trabalho, então isso que é legal na profissão, é o reconhecimento. É gratificante.

Oscar Magrini na peça 'O Vison Voador' — Foto: Divulgação

Além do teatro e do cinema, você também participou de 'Esposa de Mentirinha', uma novela vertical feita para celular. O que muda na atuação e como enxerga o futuro desse formato?

O que está acontecendo? São essas novelas que estão dando emprego para muita gente. Por quê? Se eles quiserem chamar o pessoal da terceira idade, vamos dizer, 50, 60, é meio difícil na televisão, eles pegam só jovens, não é? Então, muita gente precisa ter o plano B na minha profissão. Cada um parte para uma coisa. Graças a Deus, eu continuo trabalhando, fazendo teatro, fazendo filme, seriado. Fiz uma novela vertical, adorei, porque é bem diferente daquelas novelonas. É tudo na mão, errou, vai, continua, tudo rápido, prático, é novelinha de uma hora. Eles pagam pouco, mas está dando trabalho para muita gente. Isso que é legal. Fiz a primeira e vai rolar a segunda aí.

Após passar por diferentes fases do audiovisual brasileiro, existe algum personagem ou tipo de trabalho que ainda sonha fazer?

Eu nunca fui protagonista, eu era antagonista e coadjuvante em todas as novelas que eu fiz, são 40 com duas em Portugal. Em Portugal, na verdade, fui protagonista de duas novelas, foi muito bom.

Acho que Deus está no comando. Eu só agradeço o que acontece comigo, só peço saúde e energia para continuar essa minha atividade com a graça de Deus. É louca, ninguém aguenta. A minha mulher fala: "Você não tem mais 30 anos, é um senhor de 65". Mas minha cabeça é de 25 e a gente vai em frente. O que eu quero fazer? Eu não sei. Eu gosto de tiro, porrada e bomba porque bonzinho eu já sou, gosto de fazer um vilão. Vilão que é tudo de bom, é isso que eu gosto. Então, se pintar uma oportunidade de voltar à novela e fazer um grande vilão, eu adoraria.

Oscar Magrini é casado com a atriz Matilde Mastrangi — Foto: Arquivo Pessoal

Durante a entrevista, você comentou algumas vezes sobre estar casado há 36 anos. Qual é o segredo para um casamento duradouro?

Já sou avô. A minha filha mora em Michigan, mora nos Estados Unidos, nasceu minha netinha, ontem fez 1 ano e 1 mês. A Sofia. Não tem segredo. Eu falo há anos que a minha mulher tem uma paciência enorme. Vai direto lá para cima. Acho que conversar, ter um diálogo e prestar atenção no outro porque são pessoas distintas. Um homem e uma mulher são pessoas completamente diferentes. Ela gosta de uma coisa, eu gosto da outra, então a gente cede aqui, cede ali. Ela não gosta dos filmes que eu assisto. Ela gosta de romance e comédia, então eu assisto romance e comédia, mesmo não curtindo. Às vezes eu curto, às vezes eu gosto sim, não a grande maioria, mas eu curto mais para fazer companhia. Mas, ela não faz o mesmo comigo porque ela detesta os filmes que eu assisto, e assim vai se levando. Ela é ótima e ela sempre fala: "Ainda bem que você não é um marido tradicional, que se fosse um marido tradicional já estava separado". A minha vida não tem rotina, eu não paro em casa, como diz a minha mulher: "Você só vem em casa para trocar de mala", porque graças a Deus o meu trabalho é vem e volta de teatro, troco de mala, venho, saio de novo.

Você também falou sobre a falta de oportunidade com o decorrer da idade. Como tem sido a sua relação com o envelhecimento?

Eu não gosto de fazer procedimento na cara, essas coisas. Não me chamem para fazer botox, fazer nada. O negócio é ativação no colágeno. O colágeno com os 25, 30 anos começa a perder, então você tem que agitar. O que eu faço é esse tal de Fotona. O Fotona é só laser, nada que introduz, nada de enfiar cano, agulha, isso eu não gosto. Então, eu faço Fotona que é para ativar e é uma coisa imediata. Eu faço hoje, uma, duas horas, aí daqui 15, 20, 30 dias que vai aparecer o resultado. Nada agressivo, só externo. É o que eu faço. Eu continuo fazendo ginástica, musculação, ando para lá e para cá, tento fazer esporte, preciso voltar a lutar que eu parei, fazia krav maga, eu preciso voltar com a atividade.

E às vezes eu nem vou muito para a ginástica, eu mais falto do que vou porque eu não tenho essa neura: "Ah, eu vou viajar, vou para Cuiabá, onde tem academia? Ah, eu vou para o Rio de Janeiro, onde tem academia?". Não, nada disso. Eu vou lá, vou curtir. Se eu não conheço o lugar, eu vou passear, faço meu teatro à noite, volto. Faça o que eu digo, não faça o que eu faço. Se fizer o que eu faço, a pessoa vai engordar.

articles.title: Daniel Lopes junta Noel Rosa, Fausto Fawcett, Jorge Vercillo e IA na pista do álbum 'Já que veio, fica para dançar' | G1
articles.body:
Daniel Lopes (à esquerda) recicla a gravação do samba 'Com que roupa?', feita em 1930 por Noel Rosa (1910 –1937), no fecho do álbum 'Já que veio, fica pra dançar' — Foto: Marcelo Camelo / Reprodução / Montagem g1

♬ Quase um século atravessa a gravação do samba “Com que roupa?” – composto em 1929 e gravado em 1930 pelo autor, Noel Rosa (1910 – 1937) – e a edição do álbum “Já que veio, fica pra dançar”, do compositor, produtor musical e multi-instrumentista carioca Daniel Lopes. Pois a gravação de “Com que roupa?” com Noel é reciclada no arremate do álbum lançado ontem, 16 de outubro, em edição independente do artista.

Residente há três anos em Lisboa, capital de Portugal, Daniel Lopes manda de além-mar um álbum que recorre às ferramentas da inteligência artificial – como na formatação do samba “Eclipse total”, no qual figura o cibernético carioca Fausto Fawcett – sem abrir mão de alguns encontros presenciais entre as conexões digitais.

Se há organicidade no canto de Chico Chico, autor e convidado da canção “E tudo mais”, há IA na criação dos arranjos de músicas como “Amor, mistério e dor”, composição de Luís Carlinhos e Bruno Levinson encorpada com vozes artificiais.

Ao longo das 15 faixas do álbum “Já que veio, fica pra dançar”, Daniel Lopes promove encontros com Anna Ratto (na canção “Quero saber”), Lia Sabugosa – intérprete do hino geracional “Como nossos pais” (Belchior, 1976), lançado há 50 anos – e Jorge Vercillo, presente em “Quatro elementos”, música que se afina pela temática espiritualista com “Paz na terra”, canção composta e interpretada por João Viana.

Já “Moacir in blues” cruza tempo e espaço para conectar o saxofonista Moacir Silva (1940 – 2002) com o neto do músico, o baixista Jorge Ailton.

Antes de migrar para Portugal, onde desenvolve projetos musicais para os mercados europeu e brasileiro, Daniel Lopes foi líder da banda Reverse ao longo dos anos 2000 e integrou o trio Les Pop, com o qual legou um dos grandes discos da cena indie dos anos 2010, “Quero ser cool” (2011), lançado há 15 anos. Paralelamente, Daniel Lopes também construiu discografia solo que rendeu álbuns como “Bonito” (2012) e “Input relâmpago” (2014).

articles.summary: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' registered a significant increase in box office collections on its third day.
articles.body: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' registered a significant increase in box office collections on its third day. The action drama earned Rs 47.80 cr in India net collections on Saturday, October 17, according to Sacnilk. This represents a 28.8% increase over Friday's Rs 37.10 cr. The film's worldwide gross collection has reached Rs 317.15 cr within three days of its theatrical release. It has also crossed the Rs 100 cr milestone in India net collections.'Jailer 2' box office collection day 3Looking in detail, the film collected Rs 47.80 cr across 14,604 shows on Saturday. Its cumulative India net earnings now stand at Rs 144.60 cr, while the domestic gross collection has reached Rs 169.65 cr. Overseas markets contributed Rs 47.50 cr on Day 3, taking the cumulative overseas gross to Rs 147.50 cr. With these earnings, the film's worldwide gross collection has climbed to Rs 317.15 cr.The movie opened with Rs 59.70 cr in India net collections on Thursday, October 15. Its earnings declined to Rs 37.10 cr on Friday before recovering on Saturday. The overall occupancy across languages also improved from 48.2% on Day 2 to 53.9% on Day 3.The Tamil version accounted for the largest share of Saturday's domestic earnings. It collected Rs 34.60 cr from 7,802 shows, recording 69.1% occupancy. The Telugu version earned Rs 8.50 cr across 2,100 shows at 58.4% occupancy. Hindi screenings contributed Rs 4.25 cr from 4,554 shows, with occupancy at 26%. The Kannada version added Rs 0.45 cr from 148 shows, registering 49% occupancy.Together, these four versions generated Rs 47.80 cr in India net collections. Tamil screenings continued to dominate the film's domestic performance.'Jailer 2' theater occupancyThe Tamil 2D version recorded an overall occupancy of 74.23% on Saturday. Morning shows registered 54.08%, while afternoon screenings reached 74.08%. Evening occupancy climbed to 78.69%, with night shows recording the highest figure at 90.08%.The Telugu 2D version registered 60.55% overall occupancy. Morning screenings recorded 38%, followed by 66.27% in the afternoon and 63.18% in the evening. Night shows reached 74.73%. The film also recorded 3,121,280 footfalls on Day 3, taking its cumulative footfall count to 9,361,338.'Jailer 2' state-wise gross collectionTamil Nadu led the regional box office chart with Rs 23 cr in gross earnings on Saturday. Kerala contributed Rs 9 cr, while Andhra Pradesh and Telangana together accounted for Rs 9.75 cr. Karnataka added Rs 8.50 cr, and the rest of India contributed Rs 5.75 cr. The total state-wise gross collection for Day 3 stood at Rs 56 cr.Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar, 'Jailer 2' follows retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, played by Rajinikanth. His peaceful life is disrupted when a new threat emerges from the criminal underworld. He must return to his ruthless ways to protect his family and preserve his legacy. articles.title: Val Chmerkovskiy gets one-week suspension on ‘Dancing with the Stars’
articles.summary: Val Chmerkovskiy will not be participating in the upcoming episode of “Dancing with the Stars.”
articles.body: Val Chmerkovskiy will not be participating in the upcoming episode of “Dancing with the Stars.” The show announced Saturday that Chmerkovskiy, a pro on the competition who is paired with actor Jenna Dewan, will be suspended for a week. It comes after Chmerkovskiy posted a status on TikTok last week that appeared to reference Will Smith’s notorious altercation with Chris Rock at the 2022 Oscars. The pro had been reacting to the harsh critique that judge Carrie Ann Inaba gave his wife, fellow pro Jenna Johnson who is paired up with actor Harry Shum Jr. “You almost saw Fresh Prince enter the ballroom last night,” Chmerkovskiy wrote in the since-deleted status seen by NBC News. In a statement to NBC News, BBC Studios, the production company behind “DWTS,” said that the “well-being of everyone who works on Dancing with the Stars is non-negotiable.” “Val’s social media post was inappropriate and does not reflect the values or standards expected of anyone connected with the show,” the statement said. “As a result, he will not participate in next week’s show.” Chmerkovskiy responded to the news of his suspension by posting an apology to his Instagram story. The dancer wrote that he initially intended to “defend my wife.” “I made a poor decision to reference a meme to ‘keep my wife’s name’ out of the conversation, without stopping to think through what else that reference could imply, which was genuinely never my intention,” he wrote, referencing Smith’s words to Rock amid the Oscars spat, “Keep my wife’s name out of your f-----g mouth.” Chmerkovskiy added: “Carrie Ann certainly didn’t deserve to get caught in the middle of my bad judgment, and I hate that she was.” He also had some well wishes for those on the show. “Please send Carrie Ann, Jenna, and the whole DWTS family lots of love during Dedication Night,” he wrote. “I’ll be watching and cheering everyone on!!” Inaba has not responded publicly to Chmerkovskiy’s apology or suspension. Instead of performing with Chmerkovskiy, Dewan will be dancing with pro Alan Bersten in a number that’s dedicated to her mother. Things got heated on the Tuesday episode of “DWTS” when Inaba accused Johnson of incorporating a lift into her samba routine with Shum. The Latin style of dance traditionally prohibits the move — something that the judge has enforced in the past. While Johnson, looking confused, asked, “Lift?” Inaba returned with an immediate response. “A lift is, I just need to say it,” she said before reading off of a sheet of paper with the printed definition. “Any movement during which one of the dancers has both feet off the floor at the same time with the assistance or support of their partner. Yeah. Lift.” Later on in the episode, Johnson appeared to take the criticism well. “I will take it, sure,” she said. Chmerkovskiy has previously apologized for his TikTok status. On Thursday, he posted on his Instagram story that he had reached out to Inaba directly to apologize. “I recognize that I am in a fortunate position to have a platform and to be a role model to some, and I need to treat that with more care by actively pausing to think before I post to ensure what I am sharing aligns with who I am, and who I want to be for you all,” he wrote in the Instagram story.

articles.title: Colours of Navaratri - Day 8: Purple, with a touch of old-school charm
articles.summary: For singer Swarathmika, Navaratri is a time when she gets to embrace her love for silk saris, temple jewellery and flowers.
articles.body: For singer Swarathmika, Navaratri is a time when she gets to embrace her love for silk saris, temple jewellery and flowers. As she celebrates Day 8 in purple, she talks about why she gravitates towards the colour, her old-school approach to dressing, the singers whose style she admires and her plans to squeeze in kolu visits between a busy schedule of concerts.‘Whenever I wear purple, I feel very calm and composed’Wearing purple provides Swarathmika with a sense of calm. “When I wear purple, I feel very calm and composed. When I wear purple to concerts, I feel I look very presentable. It’s a colour that makes me look bright and suits me well. It also makes me more confident and brave,” she explains.‘My Navaratri fashion is 100 per cent traditional’A traditionalist at heart, Swarathmika believes a well-woven silk sari is a must-have in her Navaratri wardrobe. “My Navaratri fashion is 100 per cent traditional. I’m very old-school. Mostly, I will be in saris during the festival. I don't overdo anything. I love keeping it simple and elegant. Generally, I prefer no makeup and keeping the jewellery very minimal. A gold chain and minimal earrings are more than enough for me," she says. If she had to accessorise a purple sari, she would go for either temple jewellery or kemp jewellery. “Some kemp jewellery comes in purplish shades, so I'd pair it with that. I'd also wear a big necklace and a bunch of glass bangles. And, of course, flowers.”When I wear purple, I feel very calm and composed. It’s a colour that makes me look bright and suits me well. It also makes me more confident and brave‘I like pairing my saris with antique, gold-ish colours’Gold takes precedence over silver when it comes to her jewellery choices. “Since I wear a lot of temple jewellery, I like pairing my saris with antique, gold-ish colours. Almost 99% of my collection is temple jewellery. I wear silver jewellery, but I don't feel it has the completeness of gold,” she says. While she usually keeps her accessories minimal, Navaratri is a time when she wears more bangles. “As I can’t wear many bangles during concert time, I wear a lot of glass bangles during Navaratri,” she says.‘I love wearing flowers, especially purple-coloured flowers’For Swarathmika, no look is complete without flowers, especially if they are purple in colour. “I love wearing flowers, especially purple-coloured flowers. I recently went to the US for my first tour. Even there, I got myself a bunch of artificial flowers. Flowers are very important to me. I don't feel complete unless I keep flowers for all my concerts. Actually, purple reminds me of the December flowers,” she says.‘I admire MLV amma's dark lipstick and makeup; MS Blue and MS Green are iconic’Among the musicians whose style she admires are MS Subbulakshmi and ML Vasanthakumari. “MS Blue and MS Green are iconic. MS amma looked so beautiful even without makeup. I also admire MLV amma's dark lipstick and makeup. She used to light up any place she was in,” she says.STYLE FILEThe silk sari: A purple sari paired with a mustard-yellow blouse, gold jhumkas, jasmine flowers and a traditional bun is a timeless combination.The lehenga: A lilac lehenga with a silver-embellished blouse, pearl accessories, a delicate maang tikka and soft curls will be pretty, dreamy and festive.The churidar: Go for a lavender or deep plum churidar, a delicate silver-embroidered dupatta, oxidised silver jhumkas, and embroidered matching bangles. Add a soft braid with flowers and a small bindi for that effortless, traditional Navaratri vibe.The office look: Opt for a purple crop top with sharara or dhoti pants, a mirror-work jacket, chunky silver earrings and metallic juttisDon't feel like you have to match everything just because you're wearing purple. Play around with mustard yellow, lime green, hot pink, silver or antique goldBEAUTY FILEBase: Hydrating natural base with soft peachy mauve blush makes the look feel fresh. Eyes: Soft brown with lilac or shimmery lavender with a smudged wing will be the best option for eye makeup.Lips: Mauve nude with a plumper glossy lip would work well with a purple sari.Finishing touch: Go for a half-moon bindi with a hydrating finishing spray for a fresh and dewy makeup finish.Pair with a royal purple outfit, antique gold jewellery and an elegant hairstyle for a natural grand look that also gives a traditional feelGet the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.body: TRIGGER WARNING: This article contains references to suicide.Carrot Top is an American stand-up comedian and actor known for his bright red hair and signature prop-heavy comedy. Following reports of him attempting to end his life in a suicide attempt, the online personality is finally opening up about the incident and what happened to him that day.Carrot Top breaks his silence after a suicide attemptWhile he has been recovering following his suicide attempt, Carrot Top officially issued his first statement following the incident. The 61-year-old comedian took to his Instagram account to share an emotional post about everything that has happened. "I’m truly overwhelmed by the outpouring of love, support, prayers, and well wishes I’ve received over the past couple of weeks. articles.summary: Malayalam actor Aaryan has expressed disappointment over Mohanlal’s limited screen time in director Nelson Dilipkumar’s ‘Jailer 2’.
articles.body: Malayalam actor Aaryan has expressed disappointment over Mohanlal’s limited screen time in director Nelson Dilipkumar’s ‘Jailer 2’. While the film satisfied him as a Rajinikanth fan, the actor said Mohanlal’s brief appearance left him disappointed. In his Instagram review, Aaryan also compared the sequel with its predecessor and advised fellow fans of the Malayalam superstar to manage their expectations.Aaryan says Mohanlal’s screen time left him disappointedAaryan shared his reaction after watching ‘Jailer 2’, explaining that his response differed depending on which aspect of the film he considered. Although he appreciated the film as a Rajinikanth admirer and was satisfied with Nelson Dilipkumar’s work, Mohanlal’s limited presence affected his overall experience."As a Rajinikanth fan, I walked out of Jailer 2 happy. As a Nelson fan, I was pretty much satisfied. But the Mohanlal fan in me walked out with a broken heart (sic)," Aaryan wrote.Actor compares ‘Jailer 2’ with its predecessorThe actor also opened up on what made the first installment memorable for him. He praised Nelson Dilipkumar for giving Mohanlal, Shiva Rajkumar and Jackie Shroff significant moments alongside Rajinikanth. According to Aaryan, the sequel did not offer the same balance between the lead actor and the other prominent performers."What I loved most about Jailer 1 was how Nelson gave Mohanlal, Shivanna, and Jackie Shroff their own powerful screen presence alongside Rajinikanth. Even in Thalaivar's film, each of them had their own glorious mass moments. This time, that balance felt missing, with the spotlight leaning a little too heavily towards Rajini alone (sic)," he wrote.Aaryan questions missing Mohanlal shotsAaryan also drew attention to scenes featuring Mohanlal in the film's promotional material. He questioned why some shots seen in the trailer did not make it into the final version. His remarks reflected his disappointment over the difference between what he expected and what appeared on screen."Nelson bro ... couldn't you have at least kept those Lalettan shots from the trailer (sic)?!" he added.Despite his criticism, Aaryan recommended watching the film. However, he encouraged Mohanlal's fans to approach it without expecting a substantial appearance from the actor."Definitely a film worth watching! But my dear fellow Lalettan fans, better leave your expectations outside the theatre before walking in! Still a Nelson fan. Still a Rajini fan. But Ennaikkum Ennaikkum (forever), a Lalettan fan (sic)!" he concluded.Jishad Shamsudeen explains his reactionThe discussion around Mohanlal's screen time had earlier drawn response from his costume designer, Jishad Shamsudeen. After his earlier social media post about the actor's reduced portions attracted attention, Jishad clarified that his comments came from his admiration for Mohanlal."What I expressed yesterday came purely from the heart of a devoted Lalettan fan. As someone who admires him deeply, it was naturally disheartening to see his portions reduced. At the same time, as a technician in this industry, I wholeheartedly respect the creative process and the autonomy of the filmmakers. articles.title: Clint Eastwood, de 96 años, sobre Estados Unidos: "No es como en Europa, aquí no hay muchas formas de arte independientes"
articles.standfirst: El actor y director reivindica el western, el jazz y el blues como las grandes aportaciones culturales de su país
articles.summary: El actor y director reivindica el western, el jazz y el blues como las grandes aportaciones culturales de su país
articles.body: Clint Eastwood se ha convertido en uno de los rostros más reconocibles de la historia del cine gracias a una trayectoria marcada por personajes inolvidables y películas que han dejado huella en varias generaciones. Aunque su carrera abarca numerosos géneros, el western ocupa un lugar especial en su filmografía. El intérprete y cineasta considera que este género sigue siendo una de las grandes señas de identidad de la cultura estadounidense. Sin embargo, Eastwood también ha expresado una reflexión crítica sobre la capacidad de Estados Unidos para desarrollar expresiones artísticas propias. En una entrevista concedida a la revista española Fotogramas, el cineasta lamentó que su país no destaque tanto como Europa por la diversidad de sus manifestaciones culturales independientes. Una opinión que pone de relieve su particular visión sobre la identidad artística estadounidense y sus influencias históricas. “No es como en Europa; aquí no hay muchas expresiones artísticas independientes”, afirmó el director al comparar ambos territorios. A su juicio, buena parte de la cultura estadounidense se ha construido a partir de influencias procedentes del continente europeo. En ese contexto, señaló tres excepciones que considera genuinamente estadounidenses: "el western, el jazz y el blues”. “Aparte de eso, no hay mucho que sea verdaderamente original”, añadió Eastwood, que mantiene una estrecha relación con el género cinematográfico que contribuyó a convertirlo en una estrella internacional. Su reflexión resulta especialmente llamativa si se tiene en cuenta que su imagen quedó ligada para siempre a los duelos, los paisajes desérticos y los personajes solitarios del Lejano Oeste. Su vínculo con este universo comenzó a consolidarse gracias al director italiano Sergio Leone y a la conocida trilogía del dólar. Por un puñado de dólares (1964), La muerte tenía un precio (1965) y El bueno, el malo y el feo (1966) impulsaron su fama mundial y ayudaron a popularizar los llamados spaghetti westerns. Posteriormente, Eastwood también se puso detrás de las cámaras para dirigir títulos como Infierno de cobardes (1973), El fuera de la ley (1976), El jinete pálido (1985) y Sin perdón (1992). Décadas después, volvió a acercarse al género con Cry Macho (2021). La paradoja es evidente: uno de los mayores símbolos del western estadounidense alcanzó el estrellato internacional gracias, en buena medida, a la reinterpretación europea de ese mismo género.

articles.title: Llega la segunda edición de la 'Fiesta del Cine 2026': con entradas a 3,50 euros y más de 300 salas adheridas
articles.summary: Del 19 al 22 de octubre
articles.body: La Fiesta del Cine 2026 ya tiene fechas confirmadas para su segunda edición del año. Se ha anunciado que será del 19 al 22 de octubre, y los cinéfilos podrán disfrutar de las películas en pantalla grande por solo 3,50 euros, una iniciativa que vuelve a convertir las salas en uno de los planes más atractivos del otoño. La cita llega en un momento especialmente positivo para el sector. La edición celebrada en abril registró los mejores datos de asistencia desde 2019, con un incremento del 4,3% de espectadores respecto a la convocatoria de junio de 2025. Dichos números que refuerzan el éxito de una campaña que lleva ya 17 años acercando el cine al gran público. En esta ocasión, según los organizadores, un total de 321 cines de toda España participarán en la promoción impulsada por el Instituto de la Cinematografía y de las Artes Audiovisuales (ICAA), la Federación de Cines de España y la Federación de Distribuidores Cinematográficos. Una de las principales ventajas de esta edición es que ya no será necesario realizar ningún registro previo ni solicitar acreditaciones. Los espectadores podrán acceder al descuento comprando directamente sus entradas, tanto en taquilla como a través de internet. Eso sí, algunas proyecciones especiales, como las sesiones en formato 3D o experiencias premium, pueden quedar excluidas de la promoción o estar sujetas a condiciones específicas según cada complejo cinematográfico. La cartelera de esos días llegará cargada de estrenos para todos los gustos. Entre los títulos más destacados figura 'La invitación', la nueva película dirigida por Olivia Wilde, una adaptación de la cinta española Sentimental, de Cesc Gay. El reparto reúne además a nombres de primer nivel como Penélope Cruz, Edward Norton y Seth Rogen. Junto a ella también aterrizarán en las salas otros lanzamientos esperados como 'Street Fighter', la nueva adaptación cinematográfica del popular videojuego de lucha; la comedia romántica española 'La maleta', protagonizada por Lucía Caraballo y Alejandro Speitzer; y 'Whalefall', una de las propuestas más llamativas del año, con Austin Abrams en la piel de un joven que trata de sobrevivir tras quedar atrapado en el interior de una ballena. Con precios reducidos, cientos de salas adheridas y una oferta repleta de estrenos, la Fiesta del Cine volverá a convertirse en una oportunidad perfecta para redescubrir la experiencia de ver películas en la gran pantalla.

articles.summary: Aamir Khan is reportedly exploring an ambitious action film with Hong Kong filmmaker and actor Stephen Chow, best known for directing and starring in
articles.body: Aamir Khan is reportedly exploring an ambitious action film with Hong Kong filmmaker and actor Stephen Chow, best known for directing and starring in ‘Kung Fu Hustle’ and ‘Shaolin Soccer’. According to Mid-Day, Aamir Khan Productions has held talks with Chow for a project envisioned to compete on an international scale. However, the collaboration is still at an early stage, with Aamir also considering other scripts while preparing for his upcoming projects.Why Aamir Khan wants to work with Stephen ChowAamir Khan is reportedly looking beyond Bollywood as he explores a large-scale action entertainer with Stephen Chow. According to Mid-Day, Aamir Khan Productions has been in talks with the Hong Kong filmmaker and actor for an action-heavy project that could compete on an international scale.A source cited by the publication said Aamir is keen to explore the action genre on a larger canvas. While his contemporaries Shah Rukh Khan and Salman Khan have headlined big-ticket action spectacles, Aamir is reportedly interested in developing a project with international ambitions.“His contemporaries Shah Rukh Khan and Salman Khan have already headlined big-ticket action spectacles. [While Aamir has done action], he is keen to explore the genre with a film that can compete on an international scale. Given Stephen’s distinctive approach to action and physical comedy, Aamir is keen to work on something with him,” the source told the publication.Chow’s blend of martial arts, physical comedy and exaggerated action has made him a distinctive presence in Hong Kong cinema. A potential collaboration would bring together Aamir’s production ambitions and the filmmaker’s signature approach to action-comedy. However, the discussions have not yet resulted in a confirmed project.Aamir Khan’s project with Stephen Chow is not final yetDespite the reported talks, the project is far from being finalised. Aamir is known for taking time before committing to a film and is reportedly considering several scripts.According to the afore mentioned publication, he is also weighing an action film by Atlee and has reportedly asked for time until March 2027 before making a decision. The development remains unconfirmed, and there has been no official announcement of a collaboration with either Atlee or Chow. For now, Aamir’s immediate focus is reportedly on Ashutosh Gowariker’s ‘Lalkaara’, a film based on the historic 1952 India-Pakistan Test cricket series, and the sequel to Rajkumar Hirani’s ‘3 Idiots’.Reports have indicated that ‘Lalkaara’ is scheduled to occupy much of Aamir’s calendar through March 2027, with the ‘3 Idiots’ sequel expected to move forward once its screenplay is ready. The sequel is currently in development, though its production plans remain subject to the script and scheduling.Stephen Chow’s rise to fameStephen Chow rose to prominence with a series of popular Hong Kong films, including ‘All for the Winner’ (1990), ‘Fight Back to School’ (1991) and ‘Royal Tramp’ (1992). He later reached a wider international audience with ‘Shaolin Soccer’ (2001), which combined martial arts with sports comedy, and ‘Kung Fu Hustle’ (2004), a stylised action comedy that blended elaborate fight sequences with slapstick humour.Chow’s filmmaking is known for its inventive action, exaggerated physical performances and comic timing. These elements have helped establish his work among audiences beyond Hong Kong and China, making him a distinctive name in action-comedy cinema.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘His melodies will continue to resonate’: AR Rahman pays tribute to Tamil composer Deva as Sujatha Mohan remembers ‘Thenisai Thendral's warmth during recording sessions
articles.summary: Veteran Tamil music composer Deva, fondly known as ‘Thenisai Thendral’, died in Chennai on October 17 at the age of 75.
articles.body: Veteran Tamil music composer Deva, fondly known as ‘Thenisai Thendral’, died in Chennai on October 17 at the age of 75. Following his passing, music composer AR Rahman paid tribute to Deva, remembering how his melodies touched generations of listeners. Playback singer Sujatha Mohan also mourned the loss, recalling his wonderful sense of humour, generosity and the warmth with which he welcomed singers, including newcomers, during recording sessions.AR Rahman pays tribute to Tamil composer DevaAR Rahman has expressed his grief over the passing of veteran Tamil composer Deva, whose music left a lasting mark on South Indian cinema. Remembering the composer, popularly known as ‘Thenisai Thendral’, Rahman shared a photograph of the two on his X account and highlighted the enduring appeal of Deva’s melodies.Rahman wrote, “The passing of our beloved ‘Thenisai Thendral’ Deva Aiyyah brings immense sorrow. His mellifluous melodies, intertwined with the soul of Tamil music, have touched the hearts of many generations. They will continue to resonate in the times to come.”The composer also offered his condolences to Deva’s family, friends and fans. Rahman’s tribute reflected the lasting influence of Deva’s music and the affection he commanded across generations of listeners. Deva’s death was reported by The Indian Express and other publications on October 17, 2026.Sujatha Mohan remembers Deva’s warmth and sense of humourPlayback singer Sujatha Mohan also took to Instagram to remember Deva, describing him as both an exceptional musician and a wonderful human being. Recalling their time together in recording studios, she spoke about his humour and the way he made singers feel comfortable, regardless of their experience.In her post, Sujatha wrote, “Heartbroken to hear that our dearest Deva sir is no more. Deva sir, you were not just a great musician, you were a great human being. You had a wonderful sense of humour and made us all laugh during our recording sessions.”She went on to highlight the respect Deva showed to singers and musicians, adding that even newcomers felt at ease recording under his direction.“You respected every singer and every musician, and even a newcomer felt completely at home in front of your mic. That kind of warmth is rare. Thank you for every melody, every kindness, and every smile,” she added.Sujatha’s tribute echoed the affection expressed by several members of the music and film industries, remembering Deva not only for his compositions but also for the personal warmth he brought to his work. Onmanorama reported her tribute on October 17, 2026.Sujatha Mohan offers condolences to Deva’s familySujatha also remembered the music Deva leaves behind and offered prayers for his family, including his son, composer Shrikant Deva. Her message paid tribute to the legacy Deva built over a career spanning several decades, while acknowledging the personal loss his family and collaborators are experiencing.“Your songs will keep living in our hearts, and so will you. My heartfelt prayers are with Shrikant and the entire family. May God give you all the strength and courage to bear this irreplaceable loss. Rest in peace, dear #Devasir. You will be remembered with endless love, affection and respect,” she wrote.Deva’s musical legacy across South Indian cinemaDeva, whose full name was Devanesan Chokkalingam, composed music for more than 400 films across Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam cinema during a career spanning nearly four decades. He became widely known as ‘Thenisai Thendral’, a title that translates to “breeze of sweet music”.His compositions for films such as Annamalai and Baashha became closely associated with Rajinikanth’s screen persona. Deva also helped bring Chennai’s gaana music tradition into mainstream Tamil cinema, creating a distinctive musical identity that resonated with audiences.The veteran composer passed away in Chennai on October 17, 2026, at the age of 75. Reports said he had been taken to a private hospital after suffering a heart attack. The late composer's passing has prompted tributes from colleagues, singers, actors and fans, many of whom have remembered both his musical contribution and his generosity.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.summary: Una película que mantiene al espectador en tensión durante más de hora y media
articles.body: En España, uno de los géneros que más explotado está siendo es el thriller psicológico. Actualmente, se están realizando algunas de las producciones que están siendo tan exitosas que su reconocimiento trasciende a los premios nacionales. Algunas de estas producciones son ‘El hoyo’, ‘Los renglones torcidos de Dios’, ‘Contratiempo’, ‘Durante la tormenta’ u ‘Hogar’. Las dos últimas películas tienen en común que están protagonizadas por uno de los actores más polifacéticos y exitosos de los últimos años, como es Javier Gutiérrez. Precisamente, la segunda película, ‘Hogar’ es de la que hablamos, y cuenta la historia de un exitoso ejecutivo dedicado al mundo de la publicidad que empieza a espiar a los nuevos inquilinos de la que durante un tiempo fue su casa. La historia cada vez empieza a ser más tenebrosa según se suceden los cambios de personalidad del protagonista. Además de Javier Gutiérrez, el elenco está formado por grandes actores de la talla de Mario Casas, Bruna Cusí, Ruth Díaz o David Ramírez y dirigido por los hermanos Álex y David Pastor. Esta película, en la que Javier Gutiérrez ha sido nominado como mejor actor en certámenes como los Premios Feroz o en las Medallas del CEC, se estrenó en 2020 y desde entonces está disponible para los suscriptores de la plataforma de la ‘N roja’. Esta es la sinopsis en Filmaffinity de ‘Hogar’, la película de suspense de los hermanos Pastor: “Javier Muñoz era un ejecutivo publicitario de éxito, pero, tras un año en el paro, él y su familia se ven obligados a dejar el piso que ya no se pueden permitir. Un día, Javier descubre que aún conserva un juego de llaves de su antigua casa, y empieza a espiar a la joven pareja que ahora vive allí. Poco a poco, Javier empezará a infiltrarse en la vida de los nuevos propietarios, decidido a intentar recuperar la vida que ha perdido… a costa de quien sea”.

articles.body: Saif Ali Khan has offered a hilarious update on his much-discussed ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’ appearance, revealing that he is still waiting for the promised two-year supply of ghee and his prize cheque. Appearing with wife Kareena Kapoor Khan on Netflix’s ‘The Great Indian Kapil Show’, the actor revisited the moment that turned him into an internet sensation, leaving Kapil Sharma and the audience laughing.Saif Ali Khan says he is still waiting for his ghee and chequeSaif Ali Khan is not done talking about ghee just yet. The actor, who recently joined Instagram, revisited the viral moment from his appearance on Amitabh Bachchan’s quiz show ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’ while appearing on Netflix’s ‘The Great Indian Kapil Show’ with his wife, Kareena Kapoor Khan.During the episode, host Kapil Sharma pointed out that Saif had recently made his Instagram debut. He then read out a fan comment suggesting that the actor was so excited about winning ghee for two years on ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’ that he decided to join the social media platform.Kareena joined in on the joke, clapping and teasing her husband. Saif, however, used the opportunity to clarify that he had yet to receive his prize.“I just want to clear one thing. I haven’t even received the ghee yet,” he said, leaving Kapil and the audience in splits.The actor added, “Even my cheque’s not come,” prompting laughter from Kareena and Archana Puran Singh.Fans ask ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’ to send Saif Ali Khan his gheeA clip of the exchange was shared on Instagram, prompting fans to revive the ghee joke and demand that the actor receive his promised prize.“Somebody get him his ghee,” one user commented, while another wrote, “He’s so unintentionally funny.” A third fan suggested that Saif should have his own show.One social media user also referred to the popular meme surrounding the actor’s reaction to the ghee offer, writing, “I was today years old when i found out there are ppl out there who still don’t know abt the Govardhan ghee for 2 saal this is why i came meme.”Another fan tagged Sony TV and questioned why the prize had not reached the actor yet. “What is this? Your channel promised this poor guy free ghee but he still NOT received & still waiting,” the user wrote.Saif’s latest remarks have given the internet another reason to revisit the moment, which became a talking point after his appearance on the quiz show.How Saif Ali Khan’s ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’ ghee moment went viralThe ghee meme originated during Saif’s appearance on ‘Kaun Banega Crorepati’ with Akshay Kumar. The actors had visited Amitabh Bachchan’s show to promote their film ‘Haiwaan’, directed by Priyadarshan. During the episode, Amitabh told them that answering the 10th question correctly would earn them a two-year supply of Gowardhan ghee. Saif’s surprised response, “Wow, what?”, quickly became a memorable moment.When Amitabh repeated the offer, Saif reacted enthusiastically, saying, “This is it; this is why I came.” Akshay, meanwhile, could not stop laughing at his co-star’s reaction.Clips from the episode subsequently circulated widely on social media, with fans joking about Saif’s excitement over the prize. Some also described him as a “Gen Z born in the wrong era” because of his candid and playful response.Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan talk about their love for gheeThe ghee conversation continued on ‘The Great Indian Kapil Show’, where Kapil asked Saif and Kareena about the secret behind their fresh looks.Saif responded with another quip, saying, “Nowadays, we get a lot of ghee’s supply.”Kareena then shared that ghee was a regular part of their household’s diet. “We consume ghee a lot in our house,” she said.Saif took the conversation in a cheekier direction, joking about Kareena’s nightly routine. “She just doesn’t eat ghee but also rubs it on her feet every night,” he said.He continued, “Imagine, this is such a romantic thing that our bedroom smells like dhaba every night.”Saif Ali Khan and Kareena Kapoor Khan’s work frontSaif Ali Khan was last seen in ‘Haiwaan’, directed by Priyadarshan. articles.title: ‘I savoured every minute of it’: When Madhuri Dixit recalled life as a newlywed in America and waking up at 5.30 am to prepare breakfast for Dr Shriram Nene before his early-morning surgeries
articles.summary: Madhuri Dixit once opened up about adjusting to married life in the United States after marrying Dr Shriram Nene in 1999.
articles.body: Madhuri Dixit once opened up about adjusting to married life in the United States after marrying Dr Shriram Nene in 1999. In a conversation with veteran actor and television host Simi Garewal, the Bollywood star recalled waking up at 5:30 am to prepare breakfast for her husband before he left for his early-morning surgeries. Madhuri said she enjoyed those quiet domestic moments, offering a glimpse into a phase of her life away from the film industry.Madhuri Dixit recalls life as a newlywed in AmericaMadhuri Dixit’s marriage to Dr Shriram Nene in 1999 marked a significant change in her life. After their wedding, the actor relocated to the United States, surprising many fans who were accustomed to seeing her at the height of her Bollywood career. During a conversation with veteran actor and television host Simi Garewal on her talk show, Madhuri spoke about her routine as a newlywed and recalled how she would begin her mornings by preparing breakfast for her husband, who worked as a cardiovascular surgeon.“I used to make breakfast for my husband when he was in cardiovascular surgery. I used to wake up at 5:30, make breakfast for him, of course, he used to leave for work and I used to go back to sleep for some time. I savoured every minute of it,” Madhuri said.What attracted Madhuri Dixit to Dr Shriram Nene?In the same conversation, Madhuri also discussed what drew her to Dr Nene. She recalled that he had not watched any of her films before they met, meaning he was unfamiliar with the scale of her popularity as a Bollywood star. For Madhuri, their connection went beyond her professional identity. She explained that they discovered similarities in their personalities, including a willingness to go out of their way for others.“You always find some similarity when you meet a partner. What he found about me was that I would go out of my way to do something,” the actor revealed.Madhuri Dixit and Dr Shriram Nene’s wedding and familyMadhuri and Dr Shriram Nene married in a traditional ceremony in Southern California on October 17, 1999. Following their wedding, the actor moved to the United States to begin a new chapter with her husband. The couple welcomed their first son, Arin, in 2003. Their younger son, Ryan, was born in 2005.Madhuri Dixit’s return to BollywoodAfter spending several years in the United States, Madhuri returned to Bollywood with the musical drama ‘Aaja Nachle’ in 2007. The film marked her return to the big screen after her extended break from Hindi cinema. articles.title: ‘I won’t do choreographed dancing’: Sunny Deol refused steps for ‘Anthony’ but danced from the heart, while Dharmendra wanted to learn every move on ‘Ikkis’, recalls 'Shararat' fame choreographer Vijay Ganguly
articles.summary: Choreographer Vijay Ganguly has shared contrasting memories of working with Sunny Deol and his father, the late Dharmendra, recalling how the two actors
articles.body: Choreographer Vijay Ganguly has shared contrasting memories of working with Sunny Deol and his father, the late Dharmendra, recalling how the two actors approached dance sequences differently. While Sunny wanted to dance spontaneously rather than follow set choreography for his upcoming film ‘Anthony’, Dharmendra insisted on learning every step during a song shoot for ‘Ikkis’. Ganguly praised both actors for their commitment to understanding what their respective scenes demanded.Sunny Deol wanted to dance his own way in ‘Anthony’, recalls Vijay GangulySunny Deol is known for his powerful screen presence and action performances, but choreographed dancing has not traditionally been associated with his onscreen persona. Choreographer Vijay Ganguly, who recently worked with the actor on a song sequence for his upcoming film ‘Anthony’, recalled being nervous when the director told him Sunny would have to dance.Ganguly said an earlier experience at an awards show had left him apprehensive about approaching the actor for a dance performance.“The song is set during a celebration in Goa, where everyone is enjoying a festival. During the celebration, they call Sunny sir to join them, and he comes in,” Ganguly explained to Variety India.He admitted that he was unsure how Sunny would react when the director told him that the sequence required him to dance.“I was scared that Sunny sir wouldn’t agree to dance because during an awards show, he had clearly told me that he wouldn’t dance. So, when the director told me that Sunny sir had to dance for this song, I was quite nervous,” he recalled.‘I won’t do choreographed dancing’: Sunny Deol wanted to keep it spontaneousGanguly said his concerns eased once the team explained the scene and its context to Sunny. The actor understood why the sequence was necessary and agreed to join the celebration, but he wanted to approach the performance in his own style.“We explained the scene and situation to him. I wondered how to tell him he had to come into the middle and dance. But Sunny sir himself said, ‘Okay, I’ll come there, celebrate and dance.’ I immediately told him, ‘Sir, that would be fantastic!’ But he made one thing clear. He said, ‘I won’t do choreographed dancing. I’ll do something of my own, something fun.’ I was happy with that. And that’s exactly what he did. That’s what audiences will see in the film,” Ganguly said.The choreographer added that Sunny’s willingness to participate came from his understanding of what the script required. Recalling the actor’s earlier decision to stay away from a dance performance at an awards show, Ganguly said the circumstances were different this time.“This time, he understood it was a requirement of the script. He is a very intelligent actor and understands exactly what a script demands. He gave it his all, and performed completely from his heart,” he added.Dharmendra insisted on learning every step during an ‘Ikkis’ song shootGanguly also recalled working with veteran actor Dharmendra on the war drama ‘Ikkis’, released in 2026. One incident from a song shoot in Pune left a lasting impression on the choreographer and the rest of the team.Ganguly remembered that the shoot was taking place at around 2 am. Towards the end of the song, Dharmendra had to get up and dance with his friends. Given the late hour, the team initially expected the actor to perform the sequence naturally, without requiring extensive preparation.“I have worked quite a lot with Dharamji, including his last film, ‘Ikkis.’ I remember we were shooting in Pune at around 2 am. Towards the end of the song, he had to get up and dance with his friends. By the time we reached that part, it was already very late at night. He asked us, ‘What exactly do I have to do?’ We told him, ‘Sir, you just have to get up, enjoy yourself with your friends and dance,’” Ganguly recalled.However, Dharmendra wanted to understand the sequence in detail rather than simply improvise in front of the camera.‘Why haven’t you given me the lyrics?’: Dharmendra’s dedication left the team stunnedAccording to Ganguly, Dharmendra immediately asked for the lyrics and wanted the team to teach him the choreography so that he could perform the sequence properly.“He immediately said, ‘Why haven’t you given me the lyrics? Why haven’t you told me what I have to do? Teach me the dance. I want to learn it, and I want to do it well.’ We were absolutely stunned. At his age, and after having accomplished so much in his career, he still wanted to learn everything properly and give his best,” the choreographer said.Ganguly was particularly struck by Dharmendra’s enthusiasm and willingness to work through the steps despite the late-night shoot. He said the actor remained committed to delivering his best even though he was not keeping well at the time.“He immediately started working on the steps. It was remarkable to see someone with so much life and enthusiasm. He wasn’t even keeping well at the time, but he gave it his all,” Ganguly concluded.Sunny Deol and Dharmendra’s work frontOn the work front, Sunny Deol was last seen in Netflix's 'Ikka' alongside Akshaye Khanna and Dia Mirza. He will be seen in Nitesh Tiwari's 'Ramayana' and in the crime thriller, ‘Suryaa: Ant Se Aarambh Tak’, directed by Malayalam filmmaker M. articles.standfirst: Carlos Bardem llama a la movilización popular en el programa 'Malas Lenguas' de La 1
articles.summary: Carlos Bardem llama a la movilización popular en el programa 'Malas Lenguas' de La 1
articles.body: El actor y escritor Carlos Bardem intervino en el programa 'Malas Lenguas', presentado por el periodista Jesús Cintora, para analizar el panorama político actual y la situación de la izquierda ante las próximas citas electorales. Cuestionado por las discrepancias y la falta de acuerdo entre formaciones progresistas, el intérprete rehusó entrar en disputas partidistas: "No voy a contribuir al descrédito de ningún partido de izquierdas. Yo creo que lo interesante, desde mi punto de vista, es que estamos ante unas elecciones que son, yo diría, casi constituyentes". Profundizando en el trasfondo de estos comicios, Bardem subrayó la relevancia del momento histórico al señalar que "esto no va de una alternancia en el poder, esto va de dos modelos de sociedad". En este sentido, aventuró un gran respaldo en las urnas impulsado por el malestar social acumulado: "Yo creo que vamos a asistir a una movilización histórica, quizás equiparable a la del 82. Gracias a las compañeras del Sindicato de Inquilinas, gracias a la marea de la educación, gracias a la marea de la sanidad, hemos visto que la gente está en la calle, y está activada". El también escritor, que presenta su nuevo libro 'Triángulo', apeló al criterio colectivo del electorado para concentrar el voto de forma decisiva y contundente: "Yo confío mucho en la infinita sabiduría del votante de izquierdas, y cada uno sabrá a quién tiene que votar en cada sitio para conseguir un objetivo común, que es frenar al fascismo. Porque estamos hablando de fascismo. Yo no pienso detenerme más en esto, yo tengo claro a quién votaré y animo a todo el mundo a que vote, a que nadie se quede en casa". Asimismo, sostuvo que la agenda social debe marcar el rumbo programático de los partidos progresistas: "Gracias a lo que está pasando en las plazas y en las calles, a los partidos de izquierda que se presentan se les han dejado votando. O sea, el programa electoral de estas elecciones para la izquierda tiene que ser las reclamaciones del Sindicato de Inquilinas, las reclamaciones de la marea de la educación y las reclamaciones de la marea de la sanidad pública. Tiene que ser reclamaciones de defensa de lo público, y en lo público incluyo, por supuesto, las pensiones". Finalmente, Bardem incidió en la necesidad de una redistribución de la riqueza mediante una reforma tributaria justa: "Exigir una fiscalidad progresiva, exigir que quienes se están enriqueciendo... o sea, bajar esos datos maravillosos de macroeconomía que nos ponen a la cabeza del crecimiento económico mundial a la vida de la gente. Y eso se hace mediante impuestos y mediante servicios públicos. Eso es lo único que puede cohesionar las sociedades, un Estado de bienestar efectivo, y hay con qué pagarlo". Para concluir, rebatió los argumentos de la oposición sobre la economía nacional: "Hay un mantra interesado en la derecha que es decir que todo está quebrado, que todo es una ruina, que aquí no hay dinero... Mentira. Aquí nunca en las empresas se ha ganado más dinero en este país que ahora, con este gobierno progresista. Bueno, pues lo que tienen que hacer es pagar parte de esos beneficios y que eso revierta en la calidad de la vida de las personas".
